summary: Dead-end park access road beside an oval, shaded, homes 60 m or more off.
reasons: Dead-end road into park, little traffic
Oval one side, trees the other

drivers.seclusion: Backs onto an oval and tree belt. Nearest houses are about 60 m north-west and 70 m or more north-east, behind fences.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed road in from Mabel Street; gravel strip beside it and a dead-end turning area. A car sits in the trees at the end.
drivers.traffic: Only park users; the main road is about 60 m south.
drivers.convention: Park access road, so cars stopping here are normal.

flags: Powerlines cross the park to the south-west
Mapped gates 35 m and 37 m away, not on the only access
Road width at the end is modest; verge room not certain
sun_shade: Heavily shaded by tall trees on the west and north; open sky to the east over the oval.
cannot_judge: Whether the road is gated at night

best_section.where: End of the park access road off Mabel Street, by the oval edge
